encounters.text: 08:25 - Surgery: RECEPTIONIST, Test (Receptionist Access Role) / Patient telephoned requesting urgent GP appointment for a breast lump.
08:28 - Surgery: RECEPTIONIST, Test (Receptionist Access Role) / Email sent to clinical inbox.

10:15 - GP F2F consultation with Dr BRIDGES. 55F presents with 3-week history of right breast lump in upper outer quadrant. Approx 2cm, firm, non-mobile, no overlying skin changes, no axillary lymphadenopathy palpable. No discharge. No FHx breast/ovarian cancer. Discussed concern - 2WW referral being made today. Examination findings noted (XaIY1).
10:30 - PRISM 2WW breast cancer referral form completed by Dr BRIDGES. Referred to Synthetic Hospital Trust Breast Unit. Two week wait referral (XaPyQ) (New Episode).
10:32 - Suspected breast cancer (XaMeC) (New Episode) added to problem list by Dr BRIDGES. Awaiting 2WW clinic appointment.
11:05 - Surgery: CLERK, Test (Admin/Clinical Support Access Role) / 2WW referral letter generated and faxed to Synthetic Hospital Trust.
16:42 - SMS reminder sent to patient confirming 2WW breast clinic referral. Standard wording.

Core biopsy performed today, awaiting histology. Patient counselled regarding likely diagnosis and management options. Plan: results clinic in 2 weeks. Letter dictated 28/04/25 (XaIaB).
14:00 - Surgery: CLERK, Test (Admin/Clinical Support Access Role) / Hospital letter from Synthetic Breast Unit received and filed pending GP review.
11:25 - Failed encounter / N+S Encounter type / Pharmacist PHARM, Test attempted call to patient regarding letrozole prescribed by hospital - no answer. Will retry.
08:09 - Surgery: RECEPTIONIST, Test (Receptionist Access Role) / Patient telephone call - querying when she will hear results from breast clinic. Reassured, awaiting hospital letter.

encounters.encounter_type: Hospital outpatient letter (transcribed by Medical Secretary)
encounters.text: 10:00 - Results clinic with Mr HARRIS. Histology confirms invasive ductal carcinoma, ER+ PR+ HER2-, grade 2, right breast (XaJSA) (New Episode). Discussed at MDT 16/05/25, plan: neoadjuvant endocrine therapy with letrozole 2.5mg OD for 12 weeks, followed by mastectomy and sentinel node biopsy. Letrozole prescribed today. Patient consented and counselled. Letter dictated 19/05/25.

15:42 - Pharmacist drug review by PHARM, Test. Reconciled letrozole 2.5mg OD from Synthetic Breast Clinic letter dated 19/05/25 (Mr HARRIS). New medication added to repeat. Patient counselled by phone re: hot flushes and bone health monitoring. Diagnosis of breast cancer confirmed (B620.) - neoadjuvant endocrine therapy commenced.

encounters.encounter_type: Hospital outpatient letter (transcribed by Medical Secretary)
encounters.text: 11:00 - Pre-op clinic with Mr HARRIS. Tumour clinically smaller on examination, good response to letrozole. Surgery scheduled 28/07/25 - right mastectomy and sentinel lymph node biopsy. Pre-op assessment booked. Letter dictated 30/06/25.

14:00 - Major: Mastectomy of right breast (XacLJ) (New Episode) and Sentinel lymph node biopsy axilla (XaIqp). Performed by Mr HARRIS at Synthetic Hospital. Uneventful. Patient discharged day 1 post-op. Histology awaited. Op note transcribed 28/07/25 by SEC, Test.

encounters.encounter_type: Hospital outpatient letter (transcribed by Medical Secretary)
encounters.text: 10:30 - Post-op review with Mr HARRIS. Wound healing well. Final histology: 18mm invasive ductal carcinoma grade 2, ER+ PR+ HER2-, 0/3 sentinel nodes positive, margins clear. Plan: complete 5 years adjuvant letrozole, no chemotherapy required, no radiotherapy required. Discharged to GP for medication continuation. Letter dictated 15/08/25.
